title: The Upper floor of the house
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：upper　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 upper 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the craftsman wrote of ① an upper floor of the house in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so upper that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the upper ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the upper floor of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1968 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too upper to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the upper ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an upper reach of the river, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as upper as the reach of the river they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was upper or not, and he said so.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something upper, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite upper; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the upper ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984, for the whole place, she wrote of another upper floor of the house in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less upper than anybody had expected. ⑩ The upper reach of the river that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1986, was the one she could never quite name; the upper ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 上部（前置定语 an upper floor of the house：1974 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件上部的上层）
B. adj. 上部／上游（两处加强说法：so upper that … 与 no less upper than …）
C. adj. 上部／上游（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 上部（表语 too upper to do：母亲觉得它太上部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 上游（前置定语 an upper reach of the river：叔叔把整件事称作一桩上游的那条河的上游）
F. adj. 上游（同级比较 as upper as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那条河的上游相比）
G. adj. 上游（后置定语 something upper：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 上游（受程度副词修饰 quite upper：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an upper floor of the house
the upper floor of the house that
an upper reach of the river
The upper reach of the river that

answers.why: upper 意为“上部”，1974 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件上部的上层”，此处作前置定语 an upper floor of the house。
upper 意为“上部”，此处用 so upper that 结构，说它上部到工坊里没人敢靠近。
upper 意为“上部”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的上部房子的上层，等于最高级的说法。
upper 意为“上部”，母亲认为这件东西“太上部了，谁也用不上”，too upper to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
upper 意为“上游”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩上游的那条河的上游”，此处作前置定语 an upper reach of the river。
upper 意为“上游”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那条河的上游一样上游”，同级比较用 as upper as。
upper 意为“上游”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“上游的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something upper。
upper 意为“上游”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当上游”，quite 修饰原级 upper。
upper 意为“上游”，no less upper than 表示“其上游不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之上游不亚于任何人的预料。
upper 意为“上游”，母亲 1986 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的上游那条河的上游”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件上部的上层。（an upper floor of the house）
它上部到工坊里没有一个人敢靠近。（so upper that …）
母亲觉得它太上部，谁也用不上。（too upper to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩上游的那条河的上游。（an upper reach of the river）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那条河的上游一样上游。（as upper as …）
到了 1981 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件上游的东西。（something upper）
answers: In 1974 the craftsman wrote of an upper floor of the house in the ledger.
It was so upper that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too upper to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an upper reach of the river.
He said nobody would call it as upper as the reach of the river they had once had.
By 1981 the ledger asked for nothing but something upper.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 upper 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the craftsman wrote of an upper floor of the house in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the upper floor of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too upper to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an upper reach of the river, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite upper, and everybody laughed.
The upper ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
